2608.23338.title: The Emergence of Relevance Through Axiomatic Attention Patterns During LoRA Fine-Tuning
2608.23338.paper_summary: LoRA fine-tuning is standard for adapting LLMs to reranking, but it remains unclear where in the network task-specific relevance behavior is learned and what attention-level changes accompany that learning. Through ablation and attention experiments, we identify where LoRA attention updates to RankLLaMA improve performance and whether those gains coincide with interpretable relevance-oriented attention patterns such as lexical matching, rarity sensitivity, and query-document interaction. We find that given LoRA fine-tuned MLPs throughout the network, restricting LoRA attention updates to a compact mid-network region is sufficient for recovering over half of the performance gained by applying LoRA to all attention layers, and that omitting attention fine-tuning in this region hurts performance more than elsewhere in the network. Additionally, we show that regions where applying LoRA affects performance the most overlap with regions where fine-tuning increased attention to axiomatic IR features. Rarity sensitivity, document-query interaction, and several compositional features are highly correlated with gains in ranking performance. Our results support an interpretable, correlational account of how relevance-oriented behavior emerges during LoRA fine-tuning and point toward improved strategies for adapting rerankers.
2608.23338.paper_summary_zh: LoRA 微調是將 LLMs 適應於重新排序的標準方法，但在網絡中任務特定的相關性行為學習的具體位置以及伴隨該學習的注意力層級變化仍不清楚。通過消融和注意力實驗，我們確定了 LoRA 注意力更新到 RankLLaMA 的位置如何改善性能，以及這些增益是否與可解釋的以相關性為導向的注意力模式（如詞彙匹配、稀有性敏感性和查詢-文檔互動）相吻合。我們發現，考慮到整個網絡的 LoRA 微調 MLP，將 LoRA 注意力更新限制在一個緊湊的中間網絡區域就足以恢復通過將 LoRA 應用於所有注意力層所獲得的超過一半的性能，而在該區域省略注意力微調會對性能造成比網絡其他地方更大的損害。此外，我們顯示出應用 LoRA 最能影響性能的區域與微調增加對公理 IR 特徵的注意力的區域重疊。稀有性敏感性、文檔-查詢互動和幾個組合特徵與排名性能的增益高度相關。我們的結果支持了一種可解釋的、關聯的觀點，說明了在 LoRA 微調過程中相關性導向行為如何產生，並指向改進重新排序器適應策略的方向。
